description: Scrape Freelancer.com project pages from direct project URLs, search queries, category browse, or user profiles.

autoEscalateOnBlock.description: When a fetch returns 403/429/empty, automatically retry that single URL through residential Apify proxy.
autoEscalateOnBlock.title: Auto-escalate on block

categoryUrls.description: Freelancer listing URLs such as https://www.freelancer.com/jobs/python/.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted Freelancer projects.
maxItems.title: Max items

minBidCount.description: Drop projects with fewer than N bids. 0 keeps everything.
minBidCount.title: Minimum bid count

projectType.description: Restrict scraped projects to either fixed-price or hourly. `any` (default) keeps both.
projectType.title: Project type filter

projectUrls.description: Direct Freelancer project URLs, such as https://www.freelancer.com/projects/python/demo-project.
projectUrls.title: Project URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Only applied when `useProxy` is enabled.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration (advanced)

searchPages.description: Number of pages to crawl per search query / category / user URL.
searchPages.title: Search pages per query

searchQueries.description: Keywords to convert into Freelancer job listing pages, such as `python`, `react`, or `nodejs`.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: Sort order applied when crawling search query or category URLs. `latest` is Freelancer's default.
sortBy.title: Sort order (search/category)

useProxy.description: Route HTTP requests through Apify proxy. Freelancer.com is normally reachable without it; enable this only if you see empty pages.
useProxy.title: Use Apify proxy

userUrls.description: Freelancer user/employer profile URLs, e.g. https://www.freelancer.com/u/username. The actor scrapes the public projects posted by that user.
userUrls.title: User profile URLs

title: Freelancer Scraper Input
